recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見大片不規則、地圖狀（geographic）的淡粉紅色區域，包圍並切割深藍色的殘存淋巴組織，呈星芒狀輪廓，左上角仍有一個淋巴濾泡；這種地圖狀淡染的壞死或肉芽腫性發炎區是化膿性肉芽腫性淋巴結炎（如兔熱病）的低倍特徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with large, irregular, geographic pale eosinophilic zones
Pale zones have stellate, serpiginous borders and surround darker residual lymphoid tissue
Residual lymphoid follicle preserved at upper left
Pale areas appear histiocyte-rich and hypocellular, consistent with granulomatous or necrotizing inflammation
Cytologic detail such as neutrophils or necrosis cannot be resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows partial effacement of the architecture by large, irregular, geographic pale eosinophilic zones with stellate borders, surrounding islands of darker residual lymphoid tissue. A residual follicle is present at the upper left. At this magnification the pale zones appear histiocyte-rich and hypocellular, consistent with granulomatous and necrotizing inflammation, but cellular detail cannot be resolved. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis such as tularemia; higher-power examination, special stains, and microbiologic studies are required.

ddx.vs: Cat-scratch disease has the same low-power stellate microabscess pattern, so it requires Bartonella immunostain or serology to separate.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis type
ddx.vs: Nodular sclerosis shows nodules separated by birefringent collagen bands containing lacunar Reed-Sternberg cells, rather than pale histiocytic or necrotic zones.
These show caseating granulomas with giant cells and organisms on AFB or GMS stains.
